confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of local price levels and July tourist demand; no live menus, listings or booking pages were consulted. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; lodging is least certain because peak-season rates vary widely. Beer is assumed to be a 0.5 L draft and wine a standard glass of about 150 ml. Cocktail and wine are anchored to draft beer price relationships (cocktail about twice a 0.5 L beer, wine glass about 1.2 times) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general Czech price levels outside Prague, adjusted upward for the concentrated summer tourism of a small UNESCO heritage town, reasoned by analogy with similar heavily visited historic towns in Central Europe.
